decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) an early multi-sample rise in N/E with ambiguous return, and (2) a sharp jump at index ~490 with complex post-jump behavior including possible partial recovery. Both involve overlapping motion types (shifts, platforms, opposing returns) and warrant closer inspection.

regions.observation: N/E/U show a multi-sample rise in N (from ~0.3 to ~3.8) and E (from ~-1.0 to ~0.4) between indices 365–375, followed by sustained elevated N (~2–4) with intermittent E swings; U shows a broad peak around index 370 then declines. A possible opposing return or platform is ambiguous due to coarse sampling—no clear reversal within window.

Strong multi-sample jump in N from ~2.5 to ~5.1 at index 490 (within [485,664]), accompanied by large E drop (~0.0 to -2.4) and U spike (~1.8 to 3.5); subsequent samples show high-amplitude oscillations in all axes without clear return to pre-jump level. A second abrupt change occurs near index 500 (N drops to ~2.9, E rebounds), suggesting possible superposed offset or partial recovery.
